keep_hidden includes hidden elements and template text in HTTP Markdown output

```zig title="Zig"
const std = @import("std");
const crawlberg = @import("crawlberg");

pub fn main() !void {
    const _result_json = try crawlberg.scrape("{\"browser\":{\"mode\":\"never\"},\"content\":{\"extract_metadata\":false,\"keep_hidden\":true}}", "https://example.com");
    defer std.heap.c_allocator.free(_result_json);
    std.debug.print("{s}\n", .{_result_json});

}
```
